rationale: Zone 1 set to 80% of protected line impedance (26.388 * 0.8 = 21.11 ohms) to underreach the line. Zone 2 covers protected line plus 50% of shortest backup line L_BC (26.388 + 0.5*15.771 = 34.27 ohms). Zone 3 covers protected line plus 120% of longest backup line L_BD (26.388 + 1.2*18.554 = 48.65 ohms), staying well below load encroachment limit of 121 ohms. Delays coordinated as 0.05s/0.4s/1.0s.
